query: My 44-year-old female with heart failure: among females 39–49 with HF, report in-hospital mortality (%) and N by LOS (≤5 vs >5) and comorbidity tertiles (Low/Med/High); include CKD and diabetes prevalence.
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.los <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS los_lt5, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.los > 5 THEN 1 END) AS los_gt5, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.icd_code = '41508' THEN 1 END) AS ckd_prevalence, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.icd_code = '43328' THEN 1 END) AS diabetes_prevalence, percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY a.length_of_stay) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY a.length_of_stay) AS interquartile_range FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON p.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, p.dob)) = 44 AND d.icd_code = '41001';
